meta.notes:
Oracle: PSL Tax-Calculator (taxcalc) under current-law policy (no reform), Records(exact_calculations=True), credit_claim_urn forced to 0 so every eligible unit claims EITC/ACTC (taxcalc otherwise models random non-take-up). All inputs are whole dollars; outputs are rounded to cents. taxcalc computes tax with the continuous rate schedules (no IRS Tax Table $50 bins) and does no whole-dollar rounding of intermediate lines.

MAPPING (expected field <- taxcalc variable): agi <- c00100; taxableSocialSecurity <- c02500; standardOrItemizedDeduction <- max(standard, c04470) (standard includes the 65+ additional amounts and, for non-itemizers with charity, the non-itemizer cash-charity deduction; it excludes the senior deduction); seniorDeduction <- senior_deduction; qbiDeduction <- qbided; taxableIncome <- c04800; regularTaxBeforeCredits <- taxbc (ordinary schedule + qualified-dividend/capital-gain worksheet, before AMT and credits); amt <- c09600; niit <- niit; childTaxCreditNonrefundable <- c07220; additionalChildTaxCredit <- c11070; eitc <- eitc (= c59660); incomeTax <- iitax; employeePayrollTax <- ptax_was - ptax_er_p - ptax_er_s; selfEmploymentTax <- setax; additionalMedicareTax <- ptax_amc; payrollTaxTaxcalcTotal <- payrolltax.

INCOME TAX: iitax = max(0, taxbc + c09600 - c07220) + niit - eitc - c11070 for these households (asserted at generation time). iitax can be negative (refundable credits). With taxcalc's default soi_iitax=false, iitax EXCLUDES self-employment tax and the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax even though both sit on Form 1040 Schedule 2: taxcalc computes them inside othertaxes/c09200 and then shifts them out of iitax into payrolltax. NIIT and AMT stay in iitax.

PAYROLL TAX: taxcalc payrolltax = ptax_was + setax + ptax_amc, where ptax_was is employee PLUS employer OASDI (6.2% + 6.2% up to the wage base, per person) and Medicare HI (1.45% + 1.45%, uncapped) on wages. employeePayrollTax is the employee half only (6.2% OASDI to the wage base + 1.45% HI on each person's wages) and excludes Additional Medicare Tax and SE tax; the employer half is taxcalcDetail.employerPayrollTax. selfEmploymentTax is the full Schedule SE tax (12.4% OASDI on 92.35% of net SE income up to wage base minus that person's wages, plus 2.9% HI; zero when a person's 92.35% amount is under $400); half of it is deducted in AGI. additionalMedicareTax is Form 8959 (0.9% of combined wages plus net SE earnings over 200k/250k joint/125k MFS). The amount the household itself pays = employeePayrollTax + selfEmploymentTax + additionalMedicareTax = payrollTaxTaxcalcTotal - taxcalcDetail.employerPayrollTax.

See tests/validation/taxcalc/README.md for modelling differences (EITC included in incomeTax, MFS treatment, QBI, non-itemizer charity deduction, AMT add-backs, 2027 parameters being projections).
